NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi the 25th January, 2024 


9.0. 34(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 52(E) Dated:02/02/2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(ii) issued under sub-section (.) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder etc.,) Maintenance, management and 
operation of NH-365BB in the stretch of land from Km. 0.000 to Km. 59.622 excluding km. 26.000 to 45.200 
(Jeelugumilli to Pattisam Section) in the district of Eluru in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Deccan Chronicle (English)” and 
“Andhra Jyothi (Telugu)” both dated 8.02.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
Jaipur, the 25th January, 2024 


S.O. 345(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (North 
Western Railway, Construction organization) Notification number, $.O. 433 (E) dated the 2lth September, 2023 
published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, section 3 Sub-section (ii), (herein after referred to as the said 
notification) and issued under sub-section(l) of section 20A of the Railway act,l989(24 of 989) and Railway 
(Amendment) Act, 2008 ([] of 2008) (herein after referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its 
intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, 
maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely special railway project of " Churu- 
Ratangarh Doubling Project " (for Sub Division Churu in District Churu) in the state of Rajasthan. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely “Rajasthan 
Patrika” and “Dainik Bhaskar” dated 26th September, 2023 under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act; 


And whereas, the competent authority has not received any objection in the stipulated time period under the 
provision sub section ()&(2) of the section 20D of the act. . 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 


submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority, and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (l) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands 
specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances.

उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

9.0. 342(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, S.0.599(E) Dated 06th February 2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 
3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH206 in the stretch of land from Km. [74+000 to Km. 2!7+000(Tumkur Shimoga Section) in the 
district of SHIVAMOGGA in the state of KARNATAKA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Vijayavani” (Kannada) and 
"Deccan Herald" (English) both dated |lth March 2023 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

New Delhi, the 25th January, 2024 


9.0. 343(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, S.O. 605 Dated:06/02/2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH80 in the stretch of land from Km. 90.00 to Km. 25.00 (including Sahibganj Bypass) and from Km. 260.00 to 
Km. 283.00 (DLAO-Sahibganj) in the village(s) Polma, Bara Betauvna, Ambadiha, Bara Solbandha, Pindare in 
Mandro Circle, Ghodhi, Bara Panchgarh Pahar, Ghoghi Mako, Bara Lohanda, Chhota Lohanda, Gopal Chauki, 
Satichauki Pangro, Nirapara, Bara Panchgarh, Chota Panchgarh Pahar in Borio Circle and Boha, Jamni, Chhota 
Bhageamari, Banskola, Gadwa Pahad, Ambadiha, Bade Prate in Taljhari Circle in the district of SAHIBGANJ in the 
state of JHARKHAND. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification 8.0. 605 Dated:06/02/2023 has been published in 
“Prabhat Khabar (Hindi)” and “Dainik Bhaskar (English)” both dated 2/02/2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A 
of the said Act; 


40 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

5.0. 340(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 515(E) Dated:02/02/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), Maintenance, 
management and operation of NH548B in the stretch of land from Km. 0.000 to Km. 102.310 (Murrum to Vijayapur 
Section) in the district of Vijayapur in the state of KARNATAKA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Daily Kannada news paper 
samyukta” and “Deccan Hearald” both dated 14/02/2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 346(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार, रेलवे (संशोधन) अधिनियम, 2008 (2008 का 11वां) (जिसे इस में इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 20(क) की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी, भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, 
भाग I, खण्ड 3, उपखण्ड-(1), दिनांक 18 सितम्बर 2023 में प्रकाशित भारत सरकार के रेल मंत्रालय (उत्तर पश्चिम 
रेलवे, निर्माण विभाग) की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ.4097(अ) दिनांक 18 सितम्बर 2023 (जिसे इसके पश्चात्‌ उक्त 
अधिसूचना कहा गया है), द्वारा उक्त अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि को, राजस्थान राज्य के चुरू जिले 


मे विशेष रेल परियोजना अर्थात्‌ “चुरू - रतनगढ़ रेल दोहरीकरण परियोजना” के निष्पादन, अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन 
के प्रयोजन के लिए अपेक्षित है, ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की गई थी; 


और, उक्त अधिसूचना का सार अधिनियम की धारा 20क की उपधारा (4) के अधीन दैनिक समाचार पत्रों, अर्थात 
“राजस्थान पत्रिका” और “दैनिक भास्कर" में तारीख 23 सितम्बर, 2023 को प्रकाशित किया गया था; 


और, सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा प्राप्त आक्षेपों को उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 घ (2) के अन्तर्गत सुनवाई के बाद 
अस्वीकार किया गया है; 


और, सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20ड़ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में अपनी रिपोर्ट केन्द्रीय 
सरकार को सौंप दी है;

अतः अब केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी से उक्त रिपोर्ट के प्राप्त होने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20ड़ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि इससे उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट 
भूमि पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जित की जाएगी; 
यह और कि, केन्द्रीय सरकार उक्त अधिनियमकी धारा 20ड़ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है की 
राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशित होने पर इससे उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विलंगमों से मुक्त होकर

MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS

NOTIFICATION 
Jaipur, the 25th January, 2024 


S.O. 346(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (North 
Western Railway, Construction organization) Notification number, 95.0. 4097 (E) dated the 18th September, 2023 
published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated the 18th September, 2023 
(hereinafter referred to as the said notification) and issued under sub-section(1) of section 20A of the 
Railways(Amendment) Act, 2008 (11 of 2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government 
declares itsintention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of 
execution,maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely special railway project of 
namely "Churu-Ratangarh Doubling project in District Churu in the state of Rajasthan”. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely “Rajasthan 
Patrika” and “Dainik Bhaskar” dated 23th September 2023 under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act; 


And, whereas, the competent authority has disallowed the objections after hearing under sub section (2) of 
the section 20D of the act. 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority, and in exercise of the powersconferred 
by sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the landsspecified in 
the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances.

उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 25th January, 2024 


9.0. 339(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 8.0 520 (E) Dated:02.02.2023 , published in the Gazette of India No. 500 Dated 02.02.2023, 
Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to 
acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for Land Acquisition for Construction of 
Vellore Bypass from Km 47/400-Km 73/250 of NH-234 (New NH 75)Mangalore-Villupuram road in the district of 
VELLORE in the state of TAMIL NADU 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Daily Thanthi” and “Times of 
India” both dated 29.02.2023 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 

And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

2 Definitions 
In these guidelines, unless the context otherwise requires 

2. “Academic Year” means academic activities of the concerned affiliating University/ Board/ 
Technical Institution in a Year (Odd Semester followed by Even Semester). 

2.2 “Act” means the All India Council for Technical Education Act, 987 (52 of 987). 

2.3 “Adjunct Faculty” means resource person as per the guidelines specified in the Approval Process 
Handbook. 

2.4 “Affidavit” is a written sworn statement of fact voluntarily made by a deponent under an oath or 
affirmation administered by a person authorized to do so by Law. Such statement is witnessed as 
to the authenticity of the deponent's signature by a taker of oaths, such as a Notary Public or 
Commissioner of Oaths. 

2.5 “AICTE Web-Portal” means the Web site hosted by the Council at URL www.aicte- india.org. 

2.6 “Applicant” is the one who makes an application to the Council for seeking any kind of approval 
under these guidelines. 

2.7 “Approval Process Handbook (APH)” is a Handbook published by AICTE, prescribing norms 
and procedures for processing of applications submitted for grant of various approvals from time 
to time. 

2.8 “Approved Institution” means the Technical Institution approved by the Council. 

2.9 “Approved Intake” means the maximum number of students that can be admitted in a Course 
(excluding the Supernumerary Seats) as approved by the Council. 

2.0 “Autonomous Institution” means an Institution to which autonomy is granted by UGC and is 
designated to be so by the Statutes of Affiliating University/ Board or by AICTE to Standalone 
Institutions. 

2.I “Break in EoA” means break in the Extension of Approval of the Institution in the previous 
year(s) and “Hibernation” means approval in abeyance with the prior approval of the Council. 

2.2 “Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT)” means a project financing, wherein a private entity receives a

NOTIFICATION 
Aizawl, the 6th December, 2023 


No. A.208//2023-RIPANS(Vol-I)/4.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 
of the Constitution and as approved by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India vide Letter 
No.U.2026/26/2023-NE dated 03.0.2023, the President hereby makes the following rules, regulating the method of 
recruitment of the post of Associate Professor, Assistant Professor in the Department of Physiotherapy and Dietetics 
& Nutrition in Regional Institute of Paramedical & Nursing Sciences, Aizawl, an Autonomous Institute under the 


Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, namely:- 
. Short Title and commencement: - 


L.l. These rules may be called the Recruitment Rules of Group A Faculty Posts (Associate Professor and 


Assistant Professor), Regional Institute of Paramedical & Nursing Sciences, Aizawl, Mizoram, 2023. 
.2. They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2५ The number of posts, classification and level in the Pay Matrix: - 


The number of posts, its classification and the level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in 
respective posts as contained in Schedule I. The classification of posts as Group A will correspond to similar 


categories in the Pay Level of Central Government. 
3. Recruitment Norms: - 


3.] The minimum educational qualification for all the posts shall be as specified in Schedule I. The specified 
discipline for educational qualification in related areas of interest of the faculty in respect of RIPANS, 
required for the post concerned, will be as given in Schedule I, before the posts are advertised. Educational 
qualifications of recognized University and regulating Statutory Bodies, as the case may be, will only be 
accepted. In case of any doubt regarding educational qualification, the decision of Appointing Authority will 


be final and binding. 


3.2 The experience required for all the posts shall as specified in Schedule I. The crucial date for determining the 


experience required for the post shall be the closing date for receipt of application from candidates. 


3.3 Recruitment shall be made by promotion/deputation/direct recruitment as the case may be, as prescribed in 
Schedule I. Whenever the posts are to be filled up by deputation/direct recruitment, the posts shall be 
advertised in the website of RIPANS and newspapers by such appropriate methods as the Institute authority 
deems fit. In case of receipt of large number of applications, the Director may constitute a Screening 


Committee, which will short-list the candidates. 


3.4 In case of direct recruitment, the selection shall be transparent by giving specific marks for various 
parameters decided by the Selection Committee, keeping in view the job requirement for the post. The 
Selection Committee as constituted by competent authority will hold interviews of the all-eligible candidates, 


as may be required. 


35 Vacancies caused by the incumbent being away on deputation or long illness or study leave or under other 


circumstances, for duration of one year or more, can be filled on deputation/short term contract. 
4. Age limit for direct recruitments: - 


4.] The upper age limit for direct recruitment in each category of post shall be as specified in Schedule I. The 


upper age limit in respect of Schedule Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes and the other

special categories of persons etc, shall be relaxable in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 


Government from time to time. 


Unless otherwise specified in the Recruitment Rules, age relaxation of 5 years will be allowed for personnel 


serving in Central/State Government and Autonomous Institutions of Central & State Governments. 


The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the closing date for receipt of application from 


candidates. 
Method of Recruitment: 


The method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be 


specified in column 5 to I3 of the said Schedule. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selected candidates, from the date of assuming the duties will be on 
probation initially for a minimum period as specified in Schedule I. At the end of probation period, the 
candidate’s performance will be assessed by the Institute authority to decide if the candidate’s performance 
during the probation period has been satisfactory or otherwise. If his/her performance is found to be 


satisfactory, he/she will be confirmed for regular appointment on completion of probation. 


Subject to the candidate having minimum qualification and experience as specified in Schedule I, candidates 
from other Central Government/State Government can be taken on deputation basis. The period of deputation 
shall be for a period of three years which may be extended by the Director up to five years in the exigencies 


of service taking the consent of the lending department. 

Disqualification: - 

No person: 

(a) Who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or 


(b) Who having a spouse living, has entered in or contracted a marriage with any other person, shall be 


eligible for appointment to any of the said posts; 


Provided that RIPANS may, if satisfied that such a marriage is permissible under the personal law applicable 
to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 


person from the operation of this rule. 
Interpretation: - 


Where any doubt arises as to the interpretation of any of the provisions of these rules, the matter shall be 


referred to Appointing Authority whose decision shall be final. 
Power to relax: - 


Where the duly constituted Selection Committee of RIPANS is of the opinion that it is necessary or 
expedient to do so, it may for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with 
respect to any class or category of posts mentioned in Schedule I. This will be subject to acceptance of the 


Appointing Authority. 
Saving: - 


Nothing in these rules shall affect reservations, relaxation of age limit and other concessions required to be 
provided to candidates belonging to the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Ex- 
Servicemen and other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time in this regard. The posts filled earlier will not be affected by these 
Recruitment Rules, which are being notified now. The job descriptions pertaining to various posts would be 
issued separately by RIPANS as an Office Order.

NOTIFICATION 


Aizawl, the 6th December, 2023 


No.A.208//2023-RIPANS(Vol-I)/42.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 
of the Constitution and as approved by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India vide Letter 
No.U.2026/26/2023-NE dated 03.0.2023, the President hereby makes the following rules, regulating the method of 
recruitment of the post of Demonstrator in the Department of Physiotherapy and Dietetics & Nutrition in Regional 
Institute of Paramedical & Nursing Sciences, Aizawl, an Autonomous Institute under the Ministry of Health & Family 
Welfare, Government of India, namely:- 


Short Title and commencement: - 


These rules may be called the Recruitment Rules of Group B Non Faculty Posts (Demonstrator), Regional 
Instituteof Paramedical & Nursing Sciences, Aizawl, Mizoram, 2023. 


They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


The number of posts, classification and level in the Pay Matrix: - 


The number of posts, its classification and the level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in 
respective posts as contained in Schedule I. The classification of posts as Group B will correspond to similar 


categories in the Pay Level of Central Government.

Recruitment Norms: - 


The minimum educational qualification for all the posts shall be as specified in Schedule I. The specified 
discipline for educational qualification in related areas of interest of the faculty in respect of RIPANS, 
required for the post concerned, will be as given in Schedule I, before the posts are advertised. Educational 
qualifications of recognized University and regulating Statutory Bodies, as the case may be, will only be 
accepted. In case of any doubt regarding educational qualification, the decision of Appointing Authority will 
be final and binding. 


The experience required for all the posts shall as specified in Schedule I. The crucial date for determining the 
experience required for the post shall be the closing date for receipt of application from candidates. 


Recruitment shall be made by direct recruitment, as prescribed in Schedule I. Whenever the posts are to be 
filled up by direct recruitment, the posts shall be advertised in the website of RIPANS and newspapers by 
such appropriate methods as the Institute authority deems fit. In case of receipt of large number of 
applications, the Director may constitute a Screening Committee, which will short-list the candidates. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selection shall be transparent by giving specific marks for various 
parameters decided by the Selection Committee, keeping in view the job requirement for the post. The 
Selection Committee as constituted by competent authority will hold interviews of the all-eligible candidates, 
as may be required. 


Vacancies caused by the incumbent being away on deputation or long illness or study leave or under other 
circumstances, for duration of one year or more, can be filled on deputation/short term contract. 


Age limit for direct recruitments: - 


The upper age limit for direct recruitment in each category of post shall be as specified in Schedule I. The 
upper age limit in respect of Schedule Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes and the other 
special categories of persons etc, shall be relaxable in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time. 


Unless otherwise specified in the Recruitment Rules, age relaxation of 5 years will be allowed for personnel 
serving in Central/State Government and Autonomous Institutions of Central & State Governments. 


The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the closing date for receipt of application from 
candidates. 


Method of Recruitment: 


The method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be 
specified in column 5 to I3 of the said Schedule. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selected candidates, from the date of assuming the duties will be on 
probation initially for a minimum period as specified in Schedule I. At the end of probation period, the 
candidate’s performance will be assessed by the Institute authority to decide if the candidate’s performance 
during the probation period has been satisfactory or otherwise. If his/her performance is found to be 
satisfactory, he/she will be confirmed for regular appointment on completion of probation. 


Subject to the candidate having minimum qualification and experience as specified in Schedule I, candidates 
from other Central Government/State Government can be taken on deputation basis. The period of deputation 
shall be for a period of three years which may be extended by the Director up to five years in the exigencies 
of service taking the consent of the lending department. 


Disqualification: - 
No person: 
(a) Who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or 


(b) Who having a spouse living, has entered in or contracted a marriage with any other person, shall be 
eligible for appointment to any of the said posts; 


Provided that RIPANS may, if satisfied that such a marriage is permissible under the personal law applicable 
to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 
person from the operation of this rule. 


Interpretation: - 


Where any doubt arises as to the interpretation of any of the provisions of these rules, the matter shall be 
referred to Appointing Authority whose decision shall be final.

No.U.2026/26/2023-NE dated 03.0.2023, the President hereby makes the following amendment of the method of 
recruitment of the post of Associate Professor and Assistant Professor in Nursing, Pharmacy, Medical Laboratory 
Technology, Radio Imaging Technology and Optometry in Regional Institute of Paramedical & Nursing Sciences, 
Aizawl, an Autonomous Institute under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, namely:- 


l. Short Title and commencement: - 


L.l. These rules may be called the Recruitment Rules of Group A Faculty Posts (Associate Professor and 
Assistant Professor), Regional Institute of Paramedical & Nursing Sciences, Aizawl, Mizoram, 2023. 


.2. They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. The number of posts, classification and level in the Pay Matrix: - 


The number of posts, its classification and the level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in 
respective posts as contained in Schedule I. The classification of posts as Group A will correspond to similar 
categories in the Pay Level of Central Government. 


3. Recruitment Norms: - 


3.] The minimum educational qualification for all the posts shall be as specified in Schedule I. The specified 
discipline for educational qualification in related areas of interest of the faculty in respect of RIPANS, 
required for the post concerned, will be as given in Schedule I, before the posts are advertised. Educational 
qualifications of recognized University and regulating Statutory Bodies, as the case may be, will only be 
accepted. In case of any doubt regarding educational qualification, the decision of Appointing Authority will 
be final and binding. 


3.2 The experience required for all the posts shall as specified in Schedule I. The crucial date for determining the 
experience required for the post shall be the closing date for receipt of application from candidates. 


3.3 Recruitment shall be made by promotion/deputation/direct recruitment as the case may be, as prescribed in 
Schedule I. Whenever the posts are to be filled up by deputation/direct recruitment, the posts shall be 
advertised in the website of RIPANS and newspapers by such appropriate methods as the Institute authority 
deems fit. In case of receipt of large number of applications, the Director may constitute a Screening 
Committee, which will short-list the candidates. 


3.4 In case of direct recruitment, the selection shall be transparent by giving specific marks for various 
parameters decided by the Selection Committee, keeping in view the job requirement for the post. The 
Selection Committee as constituted by competent authority will hold interviews of the all-eligible candidates, 
as may be required. 


3.5 Vacancies caused by the incumbent being away on deputation or long illness or study leave or under other 
circumstances, for duration of one year or more, can be filled on deputation/short term contract. 


4. Age limit for direct recruitments: - 


4.] The upper age limit for direct recruitment in each category of post shall be as specified in Schedule I. The 
upper age limit in respect of Schedule Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes and the other 
special categories of persons etc, shall be relaxable in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time. 


Unless otherwise specified in the Recruitment Rules, age relaxation of 5 years will be allowed for personnel 
serving in Central/State Government and Autonomous Institutions of Central & State Governments. 


4.2 The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the closing date for receipt of application from 
candidates. 

5. Method of Recruitment: 

5. The method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be 


specified in column 5 to |3 of the said Schedule.

In case of direct recruitment, the selected candidates, from the date of assuming the duties will be on 
probation initially for a minimum period as specified in Schedule I. At the end of probation period, the 
candidate’s performance will be assessed by the Institute authority to decide if the candidate’s performance 
during the probation period has been satisfactory or otherwise. If his/her performance is found to be 
satisfactory, he/she will be confirmed for regular appointment on completion of probation. 


Subject to the candidate having minimum qualification and experience as specified in Schedule I, candidates 
from other Central Government/State Government can be taken on deputation basis. The period of deputation 
shall be for a period of three years which may be extended by the Director up to five years in the exigencies 
of service taking the consent of the lending department. 


Disqualification: - 
No person: 
(a) Who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or 


(b) Who having a spouse living, has entered in or contracted a marriage with any other person, shall be 
eligible for appointment to any of the said posts; 


Provided that RIPANS may, if satisfied that such a marriage is permissible under the personal law applicable 
to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 
person from the operation of this rule. 


Interpretation: - 


Where any doubt arises as to the interpretation of any of the provisions of these rules, the matter shall be 
referred to Appointing Authority whose decision shall be final. 


Power to relax: - 


Where the duly constituted Selection Committee of RIPANS is of the opinion that it is necessary or 
expedient to do so, it may for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with 
respect to any class or category of posts mentioned in Schedule I. This will be subject to acceptance of the 
Appointing Authority. 


Saving: - 


Nothing in these rules shall affect reservations, relaxation of age limit and other concessions required to be 
provided to candidates belonging to the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Ex- 
Servicemen and other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time in this regard. The posts filled earlier will not be affected by these 
Recruitment Rules, which are being notified now. The job descriptions pertaining to various posts would be 
issued separately by RIPANS as an Office Order.

स्थिर आस्तियों को संचयित अवक्षयण से घटाकर ऐतिहासिक लागत पर स्थिर आस्तियों का veers किया जाता

शुल्क, कर और आनुषंगिक व्यय तथा प्रत्यक्ष व्यय भी सम्मिलित हैं।

निवेशों को “दीर्घकालिक निवेश” के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है और उन्हें लागत आधार पर अग्रनीत किया

पेंशन निधि 


भारतीय विधिज्ञ परिषद्‌ के कर्मचारियों के पेंशन-सह-कुटुंब पेंशन नियम 4 अप्रैल, 2002 से भारतीय विधिज्ञ 
परिषद्‌ के कर्मचारियों पर लागू कर दिए गए हैं। तदनुसार, “भारतीय विधिज्ञ परिषद्‌ अभिदायी भविष्य निधि” 
को बंद कर दिया गया है और उसके स्थान पर पेंशन निधि आरंभ की गई है। भारतीय विधिज्ञ परिषद्‌ द्वारा

OPINION 


We have audited the accompanying Financial Statements of the BAR COUNCIL OF INDIA (“the Council” ), as at 
March 3], 2025, which comprise the Balance Sheet and Income & Expenditure Account for the year then ended, and 
Notes to the Financial Statements, and a summary of significant accounting policies and other explanatory information 


for the year ended 3] March, 2025. 


In our opinion and to the best of our information and according to the explanations given to us, the aforesaid financial 
statements give the information required by the Advocates Act, |96] in the manner so required and give a true and fair 


view in conformity with the accounting principles generally accepted in India. 


(a) In the case of the Balance Sheet, of the State of Affairs as at March 3l, 2025 and 


(b) In the case of the Income & Expenditure Account, Surplus for the year ended on that date. 
(c) In the case of Cash Flow Statement, of the cash flow of the Council for the year ended on that date. 
BASIS FOR OPINION 


We conducted our audit in accordance with the Standards of Auditing (SAs) specified by the Institute of Chartered 
Accountants of India. Our responsibilities under those Standards are further described in the Auditor’s Responsibilities 
for the Audit of the Financial Statements section of our report. We are independent of the Council in accordance with 
the Code of Ethics issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India together with ethical requirements that are 
relevant to our audit of the financial statements under the provisions of the Act and the rules there under, and we have 
fulfilled our ethical responsibilities in accordance with these requirements and the Code of Ethics. We believe that the 


audit evidence we have obtained is sufficient and appropriate to provide a basis for our opinion. 


MANAGEMENT'S RESPONSIBILITIES FOR THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS 

The Management of the Council is responsible for the preparation of these financial statements that give a true and fair 
view of the financial position, financial performance of the Council in accordance with the accounting principles 
generally accepted in India, including the Accounting Standards. This responsibility also includes maintenance of 
adequate accounting records in accordance with the applicable law for safeguarding of the assets of the Council and for 
preventing and detecting frauds and other irregularities; selection and application of appropriate accounting policies; 
making judgments and estimates that are reasonable and prudent; and design, implementation and maintenance of 
adequate internal financial controls, that were operating effectively for ensuring the accuracy and completeness of the 
accounting records, relevant to the preparation and presentation of the financial statements that give a true and fair view 


and are free from material misstatement, whether due to fraud or error. 


In preparing the financial statements, the management is responsible for assessing the entity’s ability to continue as a 
going concern and whether the use of the going concern basis of accounting is appropriate as well as disclosing, if 


applicable, matters relating to going concern.

AUDITOR’S RESPONSIBILITIES FOR THE AUDIT OF THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS 

Our objectives are to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the financial statements as a whole are free from 
material misstatement, whether due to fraud or error, and to issue an auditor’s report that includes our opinion.

the Standards on Auditing, professional judgment is exercised and professional skepticism is maintained throughout the 
audit. Misstatements can arise from fraud or error and are considered material if, individually or in the aggregate, they 
could reasonably be expected to influence the economic decisions of users taken on the basis of these financial 


statements.

ACCOUNTING POLICIES & NOTES TO ACCOUNTS 
(As on March 37, 2025) 


A GENERAL 

The Bar Council of India (“the Council’) is a Statutory Body created under the Advocates Act, 
96(25 of 96) by the Parliament of India. Bar Council of India having its object the control, 
supervision, regulation and encouragement of profession of law and regulation of Legal Education 
in India as notified by the Central Government of India and its income is utilized for, as per Section 
7 of the Advocates Act, 96] (25 of 96]). 


The Bar Council of India is registered under Section |2AA of the Income Tax Act, 96]. 


B (A) ACCOUNTING POLICIES 


l. BASIS OF PREPARATION OF FINANCIAL STATEMENTS 


The Financial Statements have been drawn up on historical cost convention and have been 
prepared in accordance with applicable Accounting Standards issued by the Institute of 
Chartered Accountants of India and on accrual basis unless otherwise stated. 


REVENUE RECOGNITION 

Income & expenditure are recognised on cash basis except the following:- 

(a) Present benefit obligation and/or interest component pertaining to special funds i.e., Pension 
Fund, Provident Fund and Gratuity Fund has been credited to the respective Fund Account on 
accrual basis. 

(6) Income from Investment: Interest on Fixed Deposit is recognised on a time proportion basis 
taking into account the amount outstanding and the rate applicable. 


GRANT-IN-AID 

(a) Government grants is recognised on a systematic basis in the Income & Expenditure Account 
over the period necessary to match them with the related costs which they are intended to 
compensate. Unutilised amount, if any, is treated as liability as at the year end. 

(6) Government grants related to Specific Fixed Assets are treated as deferred income which is 
recognised in the account on a systematic and rational basis over the useful life of the assets. 


FUND 
The word “fund” has been used to denote the intention to keep the balances invested ultimately. 
(i) Corpus Fund 
Corpus Fund represents donations received from Law Colleges and Others and annual 
surplus/deficit of the Bar Council of India upto 3/03/999. 
(ii) Welfare Fund 


Welfare Fund represents contribution received from Advocates in accordance with the 
Bar Council of India Rules and the same is utilised for Financial Assistance to 
Advocates.

5. FIXED ASSETS 


Fixed Assets are stated at historical cost less accumulated depreciation. For this purpose, 
cost of acquisition is inclusive of inward freight, duties, taxes and incidental expenses & 
direct expenses related to acquisition/construction of such assets. 


6. DEPRECIATION 


Depreciation on Fixed Assets is provided on Written Down Value method at the rates 
prescribed under the Income Tax Rules. 


7. INVESTMENTS 


Investments have been classified as ‘long term investments’ and are carried at cost since all 
the investments have been held in Fixed Deposits with Scheduled Banks. 


8. RETIREMENT BENEFITS 


(i) Pension Fund 


(ii) 


(iii) 


Pension-cum-Family Pension Rules of the Employees of the Bar Council of India, 
w.ef. Ist April 2002 has been made applicable to the Employees of the Bar 
Council of India. Accordingly, the “BCI-Contributory Provident Fund” has been 
discontinued and in its place “Pension Fund” has been introduced. The contribution 
made earlier by Bar Council of India to Contributory Provident Fund along with 
accrued interest has been transferred to the Pension Fund. 


Pension fund contribution is made on monthly basis at the rate of 2% of Basic Salary with 
an additional amount of १0,000/- per month as per Council decision. However, the accrued 
liabilities as per actuarial valuation under PVC method is determined as per the provision of 
notified Accounting Standard (Revised)-!5 on Employee Benefit the differential provision/ 
reversal is made at the year end. 

Gratuity 


The Bar Council of India has maintained a special fund called “Gratuity Fund”. 
Contribution to this fund is made based on the actuarial valuation as per AS-5 of the 
ICAI. The fund is administered by the Trustees appointed by the Council. 


G.P.F. 


General Provident Fund Account of the Employees of the Bar Council of India 
represents the amount of subscription of employees at the applicable rate of the pay 
together with Voluntary Contribution and accrued interest thereon. 


(iv) Leave Encashment 


The provision for unavailed leave is made on accrual basis by considering the Basic 
Salary plus Dearness Allowances for 30 days in a year subject to a maximum ceiling 
of 300 days as per BCI Rules/Central Government Rules. 


Further, provision for this fund is made on the basis of actuarial valuation as per AS- 
5 of the ICAI.

सं. 9-1/87-यू3 (ए)--जबकि, केन्द्र सरकार को विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग, अधिनियम, 1956 की धारा 3 के तहत किसी उच्च 
शिक्षण संस्थान को यूजीसी की सलाह पर सम विश्वविद्यालय संस्थान घोषित करने का अधिकार प्राप्त FI 

2. और जबकि, यूजीसी अधिनियम, 1956 की धारा 3 द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, इस मंत्रालय ने यूजीसी की सलाह पर 
दिनांक 28.04.1989 की अधिसूचना संख्या 9-1/87-यू.3 के तहत घोषणा की कि राष्ट्रीय संग्रहालय संस्थान कला इतिहास, संरक्षण और संग्रहालय 
विज्ञान, दिल्‍ली उपरोक्त अधिनियम के प्रयोजन के लिए सम विश्वविद्यालय संस्थान होगा। 


3. और जबकि, कुलसचिव, राष्ट्रीय संग्रहालय संस्थान कला इतिहास, संरक्षण और संग्रहालय विज्ञान, दिल्‍ली ने पत्र सं. 4(1)/एनएमआई/ 
2021/317, दिनांक 26.07.2021 के तहत संस्थान के नामकरण को राष्ट्रीय संग्रहालय संस्थान कला इतिहास, संरक्षण और संग्रहालय विज्ञान, 
दिल्ली से 'भारतीय विरासत संस्थान' में बदलने का प्रस्ताव प्रस्तुत किया। 


4. और जबकि, यूजीसी की सलाह पर इस मंत्रालय में मामले की जांच की गई थी। यूजीसी की सलाह पर विचार करते हुए, इस मंत्रालय 
ने दिनांक 10.09.2021 के पत्र के तहत निम्नलिखित शर्तों को पूरा करने के लिए राष्ट्रीय संग्रहालय संस्थान कला इतिहास, संरक्षण और संग्रहालय 
विज्ञान' का नाम बदलकर 'भारतीय विरासत संस्थान' करने के लिए सैद्धांतिक मंजूरी दे दी है: 

i संस्थान कानूनी रूप से संस्थान की परिसंपत्तियों को नए नाम में स्थानांतरित करेगा। 

1. संस्थान अपने एमओए को यूजीसी (सम विश्वविद्यालय संस्थान) विनियम, 2019 और इसके संशोधन दिनांक 18.11.2020 के 

अनुसार संशोधित करेगा। 

5. और जबकि, संस्थान ने पत्र संख्या 4(1)/एनएमआई/2022/04, दिनांक 10.04.2023 के तहत उपरोक्त शर्तों के संबंध में अनुपालन 
रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत की है। संस्थान द्वारा प्रस्तुत अनुपालन रिपोर्ट सत्यापन और सलाह के लिए यूजीसी को भेज दी गई थी। 

6. और इसके अलावा जबकि, यूजीसी ने पत्र संख्या 19-2/2010 (सीपीपी-1), दिनांक 03.08.2023 के माध्यम से सूचित किया कि 
आयोग ने 25.07.2023 को आयोजित अपनी 571वीं बैठक (मद संख्या 2.05) में इस मामले पर विचार किया और मंजूरी दी। 

7. अब, इसलिए, यूजीसी अधिनियम, 1956 की धारा 3 द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह मंत्रालय, यूजीसी की सलाह पर 


राष्ट्रीय संग्रहालय संस्थान कला इतिहास, संरक्षण और संग्रहालय विज्ञान, नई दिल्‍ली' का नाम बदलकर 'भारतीय विरासत संस्थान, नई दिल्‍ली' 
करने के लिए एतदद्वारा अनुमोदन प्रदान करता है। 


8. यह अनुमति इस मंत्रालय की पिछली अधिसूचनाओं की शर्तों की पूर्ति और समय-समय पर केंद्र सरकार, यूजीसी और अन्य सांविधिक 
परिषदों द्वारा जारी प्रासंगिक मानदंडों/नियमों/विनियमों/निर्देशों के अनुपालन के अध्यधीन है।

MINISTRY OF EDUCATION 
(DEPARTMENT OF HIGHER EDUCATION) 


New Delhi, the 16th August 2023 


No. 9-1/87-U.3(A)—Whereas, the Central Government is empowered under Section 3 of the University Grants 
Commission (UGC) Act, 1956 to declare, on the advice of the UGC, an Institution of higher learning as an Institution Deemed 
to be University. 


2. And whereas, in exercise of powers conferred under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, this Ministry, vide Notification 
No.9-1/87-U.3 dated 28.04.1989, on the advice of UGC, declared that National Museum Institute of the History of Art, 
Conservation and Museology, Delhi shall be an Institution deemed to be a university for the purpose of the aforesaid Act. 


3. And whereas, the Registrar, National Museum Institute of the History of Art, Conservation and Museology, Delhi, 
vide letter no. 4(1)/NMI/2021/317 dated 26.07.2021, submitted proposal for change in nomenclature of the Institution deemed 
to be University from ‘National Museum Institute of the History of Art, Conservation and Museology', Delhi to Indian Institute 
of Heritage’ Delhi. 


4. And whereas, the matter was examined in this Ministry in consultation with UGC. Considering the advice of UGC, 
this Ministry, vide letter 10.09.2021. conveyed in-principle approval for change of name of ‘National Museum Institute of 
History of Art, Conservation and Museology’ to ‘Indian Institute of Heritage’ for fulfillment of the following conditions: 


1. The Institution shall legally transfer the assets of the Institution in the new name. 


ii. The Institution shall revised its MoA in accordance with UGC (Institutions Deemed to be Universities) 
Regulations, 2019 and its amendment dated 18.11.2020. 


5. And whereas, the Institution, vide letter No. 4(1)/NMI/2022/04 dated 10.04.2023, submitted compliance report in 
respect of the above conditions. The compliance report submitted by the Institution was forwarded to UGC for verification and 
advice. 


6. And further whereas, UGC, vide letter No. 19-2/2010 (CPP-I) dated 03.08.2023, informed that the Commission 
considered and approved the matter in its 571st meeting held on 25.07.2023 (Item No. 2.05). 


7. Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, this Ministry, on the advice 
of UGC, hereby conveys approval for change of name of ‘National Museum Institute of History of Art, Conservation and 
Museology’, New Delhi to ‘Indian Institute of Heritage’, New Delhi. 


8. This permission is further subject to the fulfilment of the conditions of earlier Notifications of this Ministry and 
also in compliance to the relevant norms / rules / regulations / directions issued by the Central Government, UGC and other 
Statutory Councils, from time to time. 


P. K. BANERJEE 
Joint Secretary

G.S.R. 09.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of the Directorate General of Health Services (Library Clerk), Recruitment Rules, 20l3, except as 
respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules 
regulating the method of recruitment for the post of Library Clerk in the Directorate General of Health Services, 
namely:- 


l. Short title and commencement.—(l) These rules may be called the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, 
Directorate General of Health Services (Library Clerk) Recruitment Rules, 2023. 


(2) They shall come into force from the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Number of posts, classification and level in the pay matrix.—The number of the said post, its classification, the 
level in the pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of a said Schedule annexed to the 
rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc.—the method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications and 
other matters relating thereto the said post shall be as specified in columns (5) to (3) of the said Schedule. 


4. Disqualification.—No person- 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person; 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law 
applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 
person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax.—Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient to do so, it 
may by order, for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class 
or category of persons. 


6. Saving.—Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age limit and other concessions required to 
be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, the Other Backward Classes, the Ex-servicemen and 
other special categories of persons, in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time 
in this regard.

New Delhi, the 24th August, 2023 


G.S.R. 0.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of the Ministry of Textiles, Office of the Development Commissioner (Handlooms), National 
Handicrafts and Handlooms Museum, Group (7? Posts Recruitment Rules, 204, in so far as they relate to the post of 
Technician, and the Ministry of Textiles, Office of the Development Commissioner (Handicrafts), National 
Handicrafts and Handlooms Museum Group ‘C’ Posts Recruitment Rules, 206, in so far as they relate to the posts of 
Lettering Artist and Bromide Printer, except as respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, 
the President hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of recruitment to the posts of Technician, 
Lettering Artist and Block-cum-Screen Printer in the Office of the Development Commissioner (Handlooms), 
National Handicrafts and Handlooms Museum, Ministry of Textiles, namely :- 


l. Short title and commencement.—(l) These rules may be called the Ministry of Textiles, Office of the 
Development Commissioner (Handicrafts), National Handicrafts and Handlooms Museum, Technician, Lettering 
Artist and Block-cum-Screen Printer (Group ‘C’ Posts) Recruitment Rules, 2023. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Application.—These rules shall apply to the posts as specified in column (l) of the Schedule annexed to 
these rules. 


3: Number of posts, classification and level in pay matrix.—The number of the said posts, their 
classifications and level in the pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the said 
Schedule. 


4. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc.—The method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications 
and other matters relating to the said posts shall be as specified in columns (5) to ((3) of the said Schedule. 


5. Disqualification.—No person, - 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said posts: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal 
law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, 
exempt any person from the operation of this rule. 


6. Power to relax.—Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, 
it may, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any 
class or category of persons. 


7. Saving.—Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions 
required to be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, the Other Backward Classes, the ex- 
servicemen and other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government 
from time to time in this regard.

WHEREAS, the Commission having regard to the then prevailing pandemic situation of Covid-19, decided

WHEREAS, as per the report dated 08.06.2021 of the DEO, Kannur under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the

WHEREAS, the result of the election for 211-Ramanathapuram Assembly Constituency of Tamil Nadu, 
2021 was declared by the Returning Officer on 02™ May, 2021 and hence the last date for lodging the account of

89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 received through the CEO, Tamil Nadu vide his letter no. 8339/Ele- 
IV/2021-11, dated 16.08.2021 stating that Asan Ali, a contesting candidate from 211-Ramanathapuram Assembly 
Constituency in General Election to Legislative Assembly of Tamil Nadu, 2021 has failed to lodge the account of his 
election expenses, as required under law; and

ORDER 
New Delhi, the 25th July, 2023 


O.N. 134.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Legislative Assembly of Kerala, 2021 for 112- Ranni 
Assembly Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. 464/KL- 
LA/2021, dated 12'* March, 2021; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his election expenses which shall be a true copy of the account kept by him or his election agent 
under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the election for 112- Ranni Assembly Constituency of Kerala, 2021 was declared by 
the Returning Officer on 0200 May, 2021 and hence the last date for lodging the account of Election Expenses was 01% 
June, 2021; and 


WHEREAS, the Commission having regard to the then prevailing pandemic situation of Covid-19, decided to 
condone any incidence of late submission of the account by candidate till 31* July, 2021; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report of District Election Officer, Pathanamthitta under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of 
the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 received through the CEO, Kerala vide his letter no. EL1/2/2021-ELEC, dated 
24.08.2021 stating that Aji B. Ranni, a contesting candidate from 112- Ranni Assembly Constituency in General 
Election to Legislative Assembly of Kerala, 2021 has failed to lodge his account of election expenses, as required 
under law; and 


WHEREAS, on basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Pathanamthitta, a Show-Cause 
Notice No. 76/KL-LA/2021/CEMS-II, dated 06" October, 2021 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Aji B. Ranni, for not lodging the account of 
Election Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Aji B. Ranni was directed to submit his representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge the account of his Election Expenses with the 
District Election Officer, Pathanamthitta within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Pathanamthitta in his report no. El-266504/2020; dated 
22.11.2021 reported that in the absence of Aji B. Ranni, the Tahsildar & ERO of Ranni LAC pasted the notice on the 
wall of his house and got the signature of two witnesses on 30.10.2021; and 


WHEREAS, the candidate has represented to the Commission vide his e-mail dated 19" October, 2022 and 
has requested to grant him a few days more time to submit the account of his election expenditure; and 


Accordingly vide letter no. 76/KL-LA/2021/CEMS-II; dated 02" March 2023 the Commission has forwarded 
his representation to the CEO, Kerala to obtain the remarks of District Election Officer, Pathanamthitta and submit 
Supplementary Report as to whether the candidate has lodged the account of his election expenses and a copy of 
which also marked to the District Election Officer, Pathanamthitta as well as the candidate Sh. Aji B. Ranni. 


WHEREAS, the candidate Aji B. Ranni vide his e-mail dated 24" April, 2023 sent only Abstract Statement of 
election expenditure of Rs.1,36,256/- spent on various items without accompanied by the vouchers related to election 
expenditure as required under Rule 86 (2) of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, Candidate Registers & Affidavits 
etc.; and 


WHEREAS, the Commission vide his letter no. 76/KL-LA/2021/CEMS-II; dated 12" June, 2023 directed Aji 
B. Ranni to comply with the Rule 86(1) to (4) of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 and to submit the Day to Day 
Account Register, Cash Register, Bank Register, Abstract Statement and accompanied by expenditure Vouchers with 
the District Election Officer, Pathanamthitta within 25 days of issue of letter and also requested District Election 
Officer, Pathanamthitta to submit a Supplementary Report indicating as to whether the defaulting candidate has 
fulfilled the requirements as desired or not; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Pathanamthitta in his Report no. E1-266504/2020; dated 
07.07.2023 informed that Aji B. Ranni has not submitted the account of his election expenses as prescribed under 
law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“Tf the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses within the time and in the manner required by or 
under this Act, and 


314 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : SEPTEMBER 2, 2023/BHADRA 11, 1945 [PART II—SEc. 3(i1i)] 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and 
any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.”’; 


WHEREAS, on basis of the facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Aji B. Ranni has 
failed to lodge his account of election expenses in the prescribed manner and has no good reason or justification for 
the failure to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Aji B. Ranni, resident of — Kottayil Veedu, Pazhavangadi P.O. 
Pathanamthitta-689673 and a contesting candidate from 112- Ranni Assembly Constituency in General Election to 
Legislative Assembly of Kerala, 2021, to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either House 
of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of 
three years from the date of this order.

नैशनल स्टॉक एक्सचेंज ऑफ इंडिया लिमिटेड (एनएसईआईएल) के नियमों में नीचे दिए गए संशोधन ड्राफ्ट को सामान्य खण्ड 
अधिनियम, 1897 की धारा 23 के अनुसार महाराष्ट्र राज्य के गजट में अलोचना के लिए प्रकाशित किया जाता है। कोई भी व्यक्ति 
जिसके पास नियमों के इन प्रस्तावित संशोधनों के संबंध में कोई अवलोकन है तो वह उन्हें लिखित में अधोहस्ताक्षरी के पास एक्सचेंज 
प्लाजा, छठा तल, 'ए' विंग, प्लॉट नं. सी-1, ब्लॉक जी, बांद्रा कुर्ला कॉम्पलेक्स, बांद्रा (ईस्ट), मुम्बई-400051 पर इस गजट के प्रकाशन 
के बाद 15 दिनों के अंदर भेज सकता है। उक्त तिथि के बाद प्राप्त हुए अवलोकनों पर विचार नहीं किया जाएगा जब अवलोकनों को 
विचार करने के लिया जाएगा।

iii) कारोबारी सदस्य जिन्होंने अपनी सदस्यता सक्रीय कर दी है लेकिन 12 माह से अधिक समय से कारोबार नहीं किया है।

The draft amendment to the Rule of the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSEIL) as given hereunder are published 
for criticism in accordance with the provisions of Section 23 of General Clauses Act, 1897 in the Gazette of State of 
Maharashtra. Any person having any observations on the proposed amendments to Rules can send the same in writing to the 
undersigned at Exchange Plaza, Sixth Floor, ‘A’ wing, Plot C-1, Block G, Bandra — Kurla Complex, Bandra (East), 
Mumbai—400051 within fifteen days from the date of this publication in the Gazette. The observations received after the 
aforementioned date will not be considered when the proposed amendments will be taken for consideration. 


NSEIL Rules 
1. Rule 21 of Chapter IV of the NSE Rules, shall be numbered as sub-rule 1 of Rule 21 as under: 


1) When a trading member ceases to be such under the provisions of these Bye Laws otherwise than by death, default 
or resignation it shall be as if such trading member has been expelled by the relevant authority and in that event all 
the provisions relating to expulsion contained in these Rules shall apply to such trading member in all respects. 


2. In Rule 21 of Chapter IV of the NSE Rules, sub-Rule 2 to Rule 21 shall be inserted as: 


2) In addition to the provision for expulsion provided under this Chapter, a Trading Member shall also be liable for 
expulsion from membership of Exchange by direction/circular/notification of the relevant authority if: 


i) Trading Members who have got themselves registered with the Exchange and have not activated their 
membership in 6 months from the date of registration.
